prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints, preset customization fallback flow, interactive wait tips/stage flow, pre-path sequence reordering, interactive hotkey setup screen, and desktop welcome quick-action redesign were helpful.
Hints outside of sign-in, copy updates, layout changes, and sign-in reordering showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens hurt performance or showed no clear effect, with the exception of the interactive desktop hotkey setup screen.
Predictions overestimated gains for changes that failed, hurt performance, or showed no clear effect.
Predictions underestimated gains for unexpected winning changes with low or negative predictions, such as the hotkey setup screen, desktop quick-action redesign, story reordering, and interactive waiting stage flow.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Control Practice Screen: Adds an interactive practice screen at the end of onboarding where users test desktop pet hotkeys and visibility toggles before entering the app. (why: Support receives multiple emails about users being confused on how to control or hide their pet on the desktop after onboarding.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Recovery Preservation Sign-In Hint: Adds a helpful security hint on the sign-in screen explaining that existing pets will be synced and restored automatically. (why: 8 emails (the largest support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Controls Quick Reference Copy: Updates the headline and body text on the home intro screen to explicitly detail hotkeys and desktop controls. (why: Users reported confusion after onboarding on how to hide, summon, or talk to their pet.)
3: [home, notification] Background Rendering Readiness Notification: Enables OS desktop notifications when background pet generation completes so users can minimize the app safely. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s and users log support emails when pets fail to appear or app seems stuck.)
4: [adoption, layout] Split Visual Grid Layout for Pick Friend: Switches the pick friend selection layout to a split view showcasing pet stats alongside visual cards. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate in the funnel at 62.7%.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Stage Time Estimate Wait Info: Adds explicit step time estimates and tip carousel refresh timers during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step mean time is over 38 minutes (2336s), leading to user drop-off.)

scores.note: Interactive hotkey setup screen is a proven exception to general new screen drop-offs.
Sign-in hints consistently succeed (+2.8%) and directly resolve the largest support mail theme.
Copy changes outside sign-in consistently fail or reduce step conversion (-2.7% average).
Addresses drop-off during long wait times but requires OS integration and app release.
Targets the funnel's biggest leak (37.3% loss) where adoption layout previously gained +3.5%.
Interactive wait tips and stage flow reliably boost performance (+1.5% over 6 tests).
